summary: RAG + coverage-repair topology on LoRA adapter v2a_e1
hypothesis: Grafting the ragCoverageRepair in-context topology (exp009) onto the champion LoRA adapter v2a_e1 should combine retrieval-grounded coverage repair with the adapter's learned question style, pushing quality above either alone.
technique: A matrix sweep crossing all inference topologies against the best LoRA adapters: specifically, the ragCoverageRepair pipeline (RAG retrieval → generate → deterministic coverage-repair post-processing) from exp009 is run on the v2a_e1 LoRA adapter instead of the stock base model.
result: Scored 0.278 on the full-30 greedy eval — an improvement over the raw exp009 baseline (0.213) but well below the champion exp056 (0.440). The adapter did not transfer the topology's benefit to competitive quality, so the run was discarded.
